name: Memos
tagline: Memo hub for knowledge management and collaboration.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  memos:
    image: neosmemo/memos:0.31.0
    container_name: memos
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/memos:/var/opt/memos
    ports:
      - ${APP_PORT}:5230
    restart: unless-stopped
